concerns.text: Principle VII of the constitution requires the project to demonstrate latent‑space fidelity via distillation of *visual layout latents* generated by a frozen visual encoder. The plan drops the visual‑encoder component entirely and replaces it with deterministic structural features, merely adding a “scope‑limitation” clause. This deviates from the core requirement of Principle VII, which expects a visual‑latent based distillation target. The plan must either (a) obtain a verified dataset that provides images/layout annotations and reinstate the visual‑latent generation, or (b) amend the constitution to replace the visual‑latent requirement with a structural‑feature requirement and obtain explicit approval.
